propositions: Close transition dispatches LLM completion verifier even when ticket's Acceptance Criteria section contains unchecked checkbox items, missing a deterministic fail-fast gate.
Any unchecked '- [ ]' item in Acceptance Criteria should block close before LLM invocation, with remediation teaching message; '- [ ]' items tagged '[operator-attested]' are exempt.
Precheck must reuse the existing det_operator_attested regex matcher to detect [operator-attested] exemption, preventing drift between two matching surfaces.
Non-completion close classes (duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated) and prose-only AC blocks bypass the precheck unchanged.
Historical backtest property must hold: all verifier-passed closes (including attested-shaped items) would pass the new deterministic precheck.
